title: Firestartr Docker registry
description: A container registry's host, image types, authentication strategy and base paths.

name.title: Registry name
name.description: Name used to identify the registry configuration.

registry.title: Registry host
registry.description: Registry host without a port. The build and dispatch workflows derive the registry, repository and image tag by splitting the published image reference on ':', so a registry that includes a port yields an empty repository and an unusable image tag, and no dispatch can ever match it. Expose such a registry on the default HTTPS port, or front it with a proxy on 443.

image_types.title: Image types
image_types.description: Image types stored in this registry.

items.title: Image type
items.description: An image type supported by the registry.

default.title: Default registry
default.description: Required for compatibility with the action contract; default-selection semantics are not defined here.

auth_strategy.title: Authentication strategy
auth_strategy.description: Authentication mechanism used to access the registry.

base_paths.title: Registry base paths
base_paths.description: Repository path prefixes for service images and charts.

services.title: Services base path
services.description: Repository path prefix for service images.
